details.eligibility: 10th pass + ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in relevant trade, or Diploma/Degree in Engineering. Age limit as per CEN notification - verify on rrbapply.gov.in.
details.pattern: CBT 1: 75 questions, 75 marks, 60 minutes. CBT 2: 175 questions (Part A 100 Q + Part B trade 75 Q). Then Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) for ALP posts, Document Verification and Medical Examination. Negative marking 1/3.
details.syllabus: Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Science, General Awareness & Current Affairs, Basic Science & Engineering, Technical (trade) subjects.
details.important_dates: CEN 01/2024: CBT 1 held 25-29 Nov 2024; CBT 2 held 2 & 6 May 2025. CEN 01/2025: CBT 1 held 13-18 Feb & 11 Mar 2026; CBT 2 held 28 Jul 2026. CEN 01/2026: vacancies revised to 14,627 (Nov 2026).
